## Natural history notes

A medium-sized wolf spider characterized by its brown body, long legs, pale midline stripe, and darker markings on the cephalothorax and abdomen. In Florida, it is found in open and semi-open habitats such as fields, grasslands, pine flatwoods, sandy areas, roadsides, lawns, and disturbed sites. It is an active ground hunter that does not build a web to catch prey, feeding mainly on insects and other small invertebrates while sheltering in vegetation, leaf litter, or ground cover.
